verdict.rationale: Bruno lets you write rich-text docs alongside collections of runnable requests, publish those docs as shareable HTML, and embed a button so anyone can open a collection in Bruno. Together these approximate an explorable API reference whose examples can be executed in the app. However, nothing shows the published HTML reference is interactive or runnable, and the probe found no OpenAPI or interactive reference for Bruno itself. Missing for 10: evidence that the published docs are interactive with in-page runnable examples, any OpenAPI-driven reference explorer, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Write docs with your collections; publish as shareable HTML.
Embed a button in your README so anyone can open your workspace or collection in Bruno.
you can run your API collections with ease using simple command line commands
